scope: Follow-up to the failed strict coordinate comparison; unique spatial association and attribute validation at the documented one-metre GEE ingestion allowance. Does not replace the original failure.
distance_method: pyproj.Geod.inv on WGS84 ellipsoid, using the existing locked release environment. No coordinate rounding or source changes.

candidate_lookup.method: Search the point bin and its eight neighbors, then keep only points within the geodesic radius. This lookup is conservative for a one-metre radius throughout the enforced extent. Reject ambiguity and duplicate assignment.

numeric_tolerances: Unchanged from the parent contract; compare all 53 fields, null masks and emission totals.
acceptance: All 40,760 points must have a unique one-to-one match at <=1 metre. Every original value and null must satisfy the existing parent contract. Summarize displacement minimum, median, 95th/99th percentiles and maximum, and count original strict-tolerance violations.
result_policy: The original strict failure remains failed. A successful follow-up is passed_with_documented_geometry_difference, not exact coordinate parity. Ingestion cause and source-version provenance remain undocumented.
basis: Google documents maxErrorMeters=1 by default for geometry transformations during table ingestion. The asset ingestion manifest is unavailable; this is a plausible explanation, not established cause.
known_before_registration: The strict run found all 40,760 points outside 1e-8 degree tolerance. Three inspected point offsets and the global bounds differ by about 1e-6 degrees. All 39 emission sums and per-field null counts match exactly. Full geodesic displacement and spatially joined attribute comparisons have not yet been computed.
independent_review: Read-only reviewer agreed to separate geodesic association from strict fidelity, enforce uniqueness/coverage, and avoid causal claims without ingestion provenance.
